title: Learning To See But Forgetting To Follow: Visual Instruction Tuning Makes LLMs More Prone To Jailbreak Attacks
reasoning: The paper evaluates the safety and alignment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) by benchmarking their susceptibility to jailbreak attacks. It categorizes responses based on ethical and safety criteria, such as whether they promote discrimination or encourage illegal activities, directly evaluating the models' adherence to ethical guardrails.
